name: Erik Nyström
source:
Occupation: Bounty Hunter
Height: 6'4
Alignment: Lawful Good
Star Sign: Cancer
Characteristics: Jaded, tired, wise, kind, patient
Affiliation: None

Erik has lost his way after being discharged from his duty as Knight Commander. He's been exiled from the palace, has lost the trust of those he held dear, and now he resides among the 'normal folk' of Novus. He makes coin by taking contracts as a bounty hunter, and he's damn good at it, as long as he's sober... or awake.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/errant-kingdom]Kickstarter[/url]]

Erik can be romanced on his own or as part of a polyamorous route with Maja.
